name: Time and Location Management
description: Basisset aan aanbevolen Windows 11-beveiligingsinstellingen voor Time and Location Management.

settings.name: Allow time zone redirection
settings.description: Disabling time zone redirection prevents the system from automatically adjusting the time zone based on the device's location.
settings.rationale: Disabling time zone redirection may be necessary for security reasons, but it reduces the ability to automatically adjust the system time zone based on location.

settings.name: Configure Windows NTP Client
settings.description: Configuring the Windows NTP Client ensures that the system time is synchronized with a reliable time source.
settings.rationale: Enabling and properly configuring the Windows NTP Client enhances security and accuracy by keeping the system time consistent with a trusted time source.

settings.name: CrossSiteSyncFlags
settings.description: Specifies the CrossSiteSyncFlags setting for the Windows NTP Client.
settings.rationale: Setting the CrossSiteSyncFlags ensures proper synchronization behavior across sites for the Windows NTP Client.

settings.name: EventLogFlags
settings.description: Specifies the EventLogFlags setting for the Windows NTP Client.
settings.rationale: Setting the EventLogFlags ensures proper logging behavior for the Windows NTP Client.

settings.name: NtpServer
settings.description: Specifies the NtpServer setting for the Windows NTP Client.
settings.rationale: Setting the NtpServer ensures the Windows NTP Client synchronizes with the specified time server.

settings.name: ResolvePeerBackoffMaxTimes
settings.description: Specifies the ResolvePeerBackoffMaxTimes setting for the Windows NTP Client.
settings.rationale: Setting the ResolvePeerBackoffMaxTimes ensures the Windows NTP Client properly handles backoff retries when resolving peers.

settings.name: ResolvePeerBackoffMinutes
settings.description: Specifies the ResolvePeerBackoffMMinutes setting for the Windows NTP Client.
settings.rationale: Setting the ResolvePeerBackoffMMinutes ensures the Windows NTP Client properly handles backoff retries when resolving peers.

settings.name: SpecialPollInterval
settings.description: Specifies the SpecialPollInterval setting for the Windows NTP Client.
settings.rationale: Setting the SpecialPollInterval ensures the Windows NTP Client properly handles special poll intervals.

settings.name: Type
settings.description: Specifies the Type setting for the Windows NTP Client.
settings.rationale: Setting the Type ensures the Windows NTP Client properly handles the specified time synchronization type.

settings.name: Enable Windows NTP Client
settings.description: Specifies the Enable Windows NTP Client setting for the Windows NTP Client.
settings.rationale: Setting the Enable Windows NTP Client ensures the Windows NTP Client is properly enabled.

settings.name: Disallow changing of geographic location
settings.description: Specifies the Disallow changing of geographic location setting for the system.
settings.rationale: Setting the Disallow changing of geographic location ensures the system's geographic location cannot be changed.

settings.id: Disallow user override of locale settings
settings.name: Disallow user override of locale settings
settings.description: Specifies the Disallow user override of locale settings setting for the system.
settings.rationale: Setting the Disallow user override of locale settings ensures the system's locale settings cannot be changed by the user.

settings.name: Restrict user locales
settings.description: Specifies the Restrict user locales setting for the system.
settings.rationale: Setting the Restrict user locales ensures the system's locale settings are restricted for the user.

settings.name: Configure Time Zone
settings.description: Specifies the Configure Time Zone setting for the system.
settings.rationale: Setting the Configure Time Zone ensures the system's time zone is properly configured.

settings.name: Change System Time
settings.description: Specifies the Change System Time setting for the system.
settings.rationale: Setting the Change System Time ensures the system's time can only be changed by authorized users.

settings.name: Change Time Zone
settings.description: Specifies the Change Time Zone setting for the system.
settings.rationale: Setting the Change Time Zone ensures the system's time zone can only be changed by authorized users.

changelog.notes: Release of Time and Location Management baseline version 1.0.0
